ios.desc:
Ribbon is a native iPhone and iPad app for Linkding, the fast, self-hosted bookmark manager. Browse, search, and save your bookmarks from anywhere — your data stays on your server, always.

Features

- Browse your bookmarks with filter pills: All, Unread, Untagged, and Archived
- Search across active and archived bookmarks simultaneously
- Add bookmarks with automatic title and description prefill
- Save from Safari or any app with the share extension
- Clipboard detection — Ribbon offers to use a URL you already copied
- Organize with tags and smart Bundles
- Archive, edit, and delete with swipe actions or press-and-hold menus
- Bulk actions — archive, delete, tag, or mark multiple bookmarks at once
- Secure credential storage in the iOS Keychain

Requirements

Ribbon requires a running Linkding instance. Linkding is a free, open-source bookmark manager you self-host on your own server or NAS. Visit linkding.link to get started.

Your Linkding API token can be found under Settings → API Access in your Linkding instance.
